finding: Qwen3.5's visual path is not equivalent to Qwen3-VL's DeepStack path. Qwen3.5 deletes DeepStack helper structures and returns pre-merger last_hidden_state plus merged pooler_output. For Frank MVC this opens a concrete feature-strata question: public LLM-facing projected/merged token embeddings versus pre-merger vision features.
ancestry: independent upstream implementations but related model family; not independent scientific replication
internal_comparison: Existing QNDRF-1 already proposed raw Qwen/mmproj prototypes and coarse spatial pooling. This package does not repeat that claim; it adds explicit representation-layer discrimination and validates a public precomputed-embedding decode path.
